For imports, line-item editors, setup checklists, context switching, plan/usage, team/member management, review panels, timelines, detail dialogs, charts, trees, flow maps and printable documents, keep product data/commands local and extract generic presentation/interaction into Bs components.

decisions.title: Strict mode is mechanically parsed, not regex-certified
decisions.decision_text: Use Vue SFC/template AST parsing to inventory and enforce the Bs-only template boundary. Migration mode records exact legacy debt and blocks new debt. Final strict mode requires an empty debt manifest. Regex source checks may supplement but cannot be the only proof.

decisions.title: UI vendors are shared-package implementation details
decisions.decision_text: Suit source must not import PrimeVue, HugeIcons, GSAP, Motion, Lenis, Rive or another UI foundation directly for presentation. packages/ui/packages/ux/packages/nuxt-layer own those integrations. Remove duplicated app package dependencies when the shared layer can own them without breaking builds.
